tools.name: collect_bug_report
tools.description: Run istioctl bug-report against the current cluster and load the results for analysis

istio_version.description: Istio version to download (e.g. '1.31.2'). Auto-detected from cluster if omitted.

tools.name: load_bug_report
tools.description: Load an existing istioctl bug-report archive (.tar.gz) or pre-extracted directory for analysis. Archives are extracted to a temporary directory after a free-space check; it is deleted when another report is loaded or the server exits. Gives a data-completeness verdict and warns up front, from file sizes, when a cluster dump will not fit in the server heap.

path.description: Path to .tar.gz archive or pre-extracted directory

extract_dir.description: Existing directory to extract a .tar.gz into (default: the system temp directory). Use a larger volume for big archives.

tools.name: get_analyze_results
tools.description: Get istioctl analyze results (IST codes) with a count per code. Filter by severity or code; results are paged (default 200).

tools.name: get_cluster_resources
tools.description: Query Kubernetes resources from the bug report. Filter by kind, namespace, name. Paged with limit/offset; a page also stops before ~100,000 characters.

full.description: Return full objects (JSON) instead of summary table

offset.description: Skip this many matching resources (for paging)

tools.name: get_proxy_config
tools.description: Get Envoy proxy configuration for a specific pod. Sections: config_dump, listeners, clusters, certs, memory, server_info, stats. Output over ~100,000 characters is paged with offset.

offset.description: Character offset to start from (for paging)

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Get logs from proxy, istiod, operator, or cni components. Supports severity/keyword filtering and tail. Returns the most recent lines unless offset is given; output stops before ~100,000 characters.

severity.description: Filter lines containing this severity (error, warn, info)

tail.description: Return only the last N lines

offset.description: Page forward from this matching line (0 = oldest) instead of returning the most recent lines

tools.name: get_istiod_debug
tools.description: Get data from istiod debug endpoints (syncz, configz, mesh, push_status, adsz, endpointz, etc.). Output over ~100,000 characters is paged with offset.

endpoint.description: Debug endpoint name (e.g. syncz, configz, mesh). Empty to list available.

offset.description: Character offset to start from (for paging)

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Get a high-level overview of the loaded bug report: versions, pod counts (and proxy dirs with no live pod), analyze result summary, data-completeness verdict, and cluster dump size warnings

tools.name: get_versions
tools.description: Get the full version matrix (client, control plane, data plane) with skew detection

tools.name: run_diagnostics
tools.description: Run built-in diagnostic templates against the loaded bug report to find known issues. Output starts with the data-completeness verdict: findings that rely on missing data may be absent or wrong.

categories.description: Comma-separated categories to check (e.g. 'version,config'). Omit for all.

tools.name: find_errors
tools.description: Scan all logs for error/warning lines and group them into patterns (volatile tokens such as timestamps, IPs, ids and durations normalized), with the number of pods per pattern. Errors rank before warnings, then by count; known noise (probe and metrics-scrape failures, etc.) is tagged and listed last. Patterns are paged with limit/offset.

keyword.description: Filter to lines containing this keyword

tools.name: estimate_resource_savings
tools.description: Estimate CPU/memory savings from sidecar-to-ambient migration, or analyze current mesh resource footprint. Reports per-namespace breakdown and optimization opportunities.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List all files in the loaded bug report archive. Large archives are paged with offset.

tools.name: get_raw_file
tools.description: Read a raw file from the bug report archive by its relative path. Files of any size are read by byte range: at most ~100,000 bytes per call, ending on a line boundary, with a footer giving the offset of the next range.

offset.description: Byte offset to start reading from (default 0)

length.description: Max bytes to return (default and max 98000)
